summary.assessment: All pairs, all four options, runtime reversal, contexts and reverse contexts were read. The four options give one best answer in both directions under the proposed sense contexts. No spelling or grammar correction to existing terms was necessary. B1 suitability was judged as receptive vocabulary practice with context, not as official CEFR word classification.
summary.changes: Only natural sense contexts are proposed; keep all word pairs, options, IDs, correct-option positions, level assignments and active statuses. All existing eight contextual items pass. Inactive items remain inactive; their inactive status is not treated as evidence of a language error.
